name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Decision (EU) 2015/1814 as regards the market stability reserve for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors
part_text:
The European Union runs a carbon market where companies buy permits to pollute. A new permit system for heating buildings and road transport starts in 2027. This report sets Parliament's position on changes to the reserve that manages permit supply. It asks for permits to be released faster when prices spike, keeps unused permits valid longer, and calls on the Commission to study the social impact on households and consider extra safeguards for vulnerable people.

- Permits released faster when prices spike: within 30 days instead of two months.
- Unused permits stay valid until 2033, half until 2035; affects households and transport users.
- Next: Parliament and Council negotiate the final text.
